The First Hot Dish Recipe
By: Ben Myhre
Published: Thursday, March 15, 2018 - 9:55am

Ingredients




2 pounds of hamburger
2 Onions
16 Ounces Creammete Rotini Pasta
1 can condensed tomato soup
28 oz canned diced tomatoes
1 can peas
2 cups celery, chopped
1/2 cup water
salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Cook pasta per package 2 Fry hamburger until done 3 Preheat oven to 350 4 Add all ingredients to 9x13 baking dish and mix 5 Bake for 45 minutes 6 Serve​

About

Looking for hotdish recipes? Why not try the first and original hotdish recipe? This classic hot dish is easy and feeds the whole family. We literally scoured the internet to find the first hotdish recipe and we found it. While the dish is simple, it really is one that is timeless and still holds up today. This recipe that came from a church cookbook in 1930 still is tasty and uses ingredients that are common today.
